card.name: Linking words in policy and environment prose
card.fires_on: Small linking or modifier words (to, a, on, non, limited, federal, -term) inside government and environmental policy text about resources, pollution, energy or transport. They sit just before a noun phrase about capacity, procurement or sources.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short words like to, on, a that come before a resource or growth phrase.
modes.example: limited ability<< to>> expand freeway capacity due to construction costs,

modes.label: Modifiers and hyphen parts
modes.description: Words like non, limited, federal or -term that start a compound before a policy or pollution noun.
modes.example: controlling pollution from dispersed or<< non>>point sources of pollution.
